LightningComponentBundle.description: Rich text editor flow screen component that uploads pasted images as real ContentDocuments so they post inline to the native Chatter feed. Type @ to mention a user, same as native Chatter.

property.name: recordId
property.label: Parent Record Id
property.description: The record to link uploaded images to and post the FeedItem on. Pass {!recordId} from flow context.

property.name: placeholder
property.label: Placeholder Text
property.default: Type your comment here. Paste screenshots directly with Ctrl+V...

property.name: disableAdvancedTools
property.label: Disable Advanced Tools
property.description: If true, toolbar only shows basic formatting (bold, italic, underline, list, link).

property.name: hideVisibilitySelector
property.label: Hide Visibility Selector
property.description: Hide the 'To' dropdown and always use Default Visibility.

property.name: disableMentions
property.label: Disable Mentions
property.description: Turn off @mention typeahead if you don't want mention support.

property.name: hideMentionButton
property.label: (Deprecated - unused)
property.description: Deprecated: the old Mention button was replaced by @mention typeahead. Kept only so existing flow versions that set this value don't break; has no effect.

property.name: initialEditorHeight
property.label: Initial Editor Height (px)
property.description: Starting height of the comment box before the user drags to resize.

property.name: minEditorHeight
property.label: Minimum Editor Height (px)
property.description: Smallest height the user can drag the comment box down to.

property.name: maxEditorHeight
property.label: Maximum Editor Height (px)
property.description: Largest height the user can drag the comment box up to.

property.name: richTextValue
property.label: Rich Text Value
property.description: Bidirectional. Read this in subsequent flow elements to get the HTML to post.

property.name: selectedVisibility
property.label: Selected Visibility
property.description: Bidirectional. Read this to get the user's choice (InternalUsers or AllUsers).
